query: SELECT estoqueLocal, COUNT(*) as qtd, ROUND(SUM(quantidade)) as totalQtd FROM stock_items WHERE empresaDona = 'PALITOS INDUSTRIA' AND grupoCodigo IN ('20', '21') GROUP BY estoqueLocal ORDER BY estoqueLocal;
